Title: M2 — CSV importer: parsing and mapping
Description:
## Parsing

Use a real CSV parser, not a split on commas. Descriptions contain commas, newlines, quotes and fenced code blocks — every one of which breaks naive parsing, and quietly.

## Mapping

* **Statuses** — Linear's states onto the seeded six. "Verify" maps to "In Review"
* **Labels** — created on the fly, preserving names

```ts
const priorities = [1, 2, 3];
const label = "Improvement, Bug";
```
